newsitem.title: UK: Graseby says gets 22 mln stg Swiss contract.
newsitem.headline: Graseby says gets 22 mln stg Swiss contract.

text.p: Graseby Plc, a UK electronic instruments group, said on Monday that its subsidiary Graseby Dynamics Ltd had won a three-year production contract worth more than 22 million stg from the Swiss Defence Procurement agency.
Graseby said the contract was subject to Swiss parliamentary approval. Deliveries of the CAM Chemical Agent Monitors were expected to begin in 1998, it added in a statement.

"We are extremely pleased with this decision...which is yet another affirmation of Graseby's position as the world's leading supplier of chemical warfare monitoring equipment. Prospects for further orders for our chemical agent monitoring equipment are excellent," the group said.
